audit.note: the seven pressable Avatars toast client-side via control_global MESSAGE_TOAST.show with '{0} Pressed' filled by $event.oSource.sId (roundtrip-free); the LightBox opens by the Avatar itself - the app has no on_event

deviations.what: the sap.m.Avatar control (since UI5 1.73) is newer than 1.71 and is the whole point of this sample - kept 1:1 (including its detailBox aggregation with the LightBox/LightBoxItem), the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.73.

the Avatar properties badgeIcon and badgeTooltip (since UI5 1.77) are what this sample demonstrates and are kept 1:1 - the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.77 to render the affordance badges and their tooltips.

onInit's JSONModel (GettyImages/Shutterstock/LowShutterstock/LightBox = sap.ui.require.toUrl('sap/m/images/...')) is seeded in model_init as default-model root fields of the same names; the module paths have no server-side resolution, so they are pinned to the OpenUI5 host https://sdk.openui5.org/test-resources/sap/m/images/ (same file names, the folder the sample's resourceRoots sap.m.images points at) per the runtime asset-URL rule. The bindings Avatar.src {/GettyImages} {/Shutterstock} {/LowShutterstock} {/LightBox} and LightBoxItem.imageSrc {/LightBox} stay bindings (client->_bind), which structural-diff cannot read statically.

onPress toasts oEvent.getSource().getId() + ' Pressed'. All 7 press wires reproduce that client-side and roundtrip-free (follow_up_action control_global MESSAGE_TOAST.show, template '{0} Pressed' filled by $event.oSource.sId, app 127 precedent); the id itself is a UI5 runtime value whose view prefix differs from the original's.
